axes.name: CROSS-SECTIONAL MOMENTUM / REVERSAL LOADING
axes.attack: 'Buy the under-mover, sell the over-mover' is mechanically short-horizon reversal; and the H=24 bar hold with 1:-beta leg sizing can carry multi-day momentum loading through either leg. Residualization cancels the COMMON state but not per-LEG momentum/reversal differences.
binding_forms_exact: REVERSAL: rev24_s = -(sum of last 24 H1 log returns of leg s), cross-sectionally z-scored across the 3 symbols at each entry, rendered same-bet over the anchor's entry/exit windows; bar 0.20 both statistics, min pairs 8
MOMENTUM: mom168_s = sum of last 168 H1 log returns of leg s, same rendering and bar; plus tsmom28 from the 29-shape inventory at daily scale
PAIR-LEVEL: the pair's own spread return over trailing 168 bars, lagged >= 1 bar (PIT), same-bet — if the book earns by continuing the recent spread trend, the dislocation-convergence story is false
all forms at stress-2.0 book return correlation and state-correlation both reported; any |rho| > 0.20 -> D2 VETO with margin (F1)

The NG3 hazard stands: event-triggered population per fold is NOT guaranteed by any validity arithmetic (NG3 A5 fold1 got 2 traded episodes out of 106 evaluable days).
axes.binding_fold_rule_text: Folds are contiguous calendar-time UTC intervals of the decision clock, assigned by decision bar index alone, independent of signal state, event count, or any measured performance; boundaries are exact UTC timestamps frozen in the cycle plan before any D1 computation; any fold containing fewer than 4 anchor decisions per cell kills the family pre-selection (NG3-A5 2<4 precedent); decisions are never moved, dropped, or reassigned across folds; holding windows that would cross a boundary are force-flat (declared truncation, counted as early-exit exits in the return distribution) — never excluded silently and never assigned to the neighboring fold.

axes.name: FUNDING
axes.attack: The cost line is INCOMPLETE as written. (i) No sign convention: for long legA / short legB, settlement cash flow = -f_A * N_A (long pays positive funding) + f_B * N_B (short receives); A2 never states sides, nor that legs carry UNEQUAL notionals (1 : -beta) so funding must be notional-weighted per leg. (ii) 'up to 3 settlements x 2 legs per 1-day hold' HARDCODES an 8h cadence; Binance USD-M funding intervals are symbol- and regime-dependent (4h/1h adjustments happen in stress — exactly the states BETDIS enters), so the settlement count must be MEASURED from the re-proved per-symbol streams, not assumed. (iii) No boundary rule for a settlement timestamp coinciding with entry or exit. (iv) Three separate per-symbol streams (BTC/ETH/SOL) must each be sha-pinned; NG2 funding bytes are absent from this tree and NG3 funding legs closed NOT_RUN_BLOCKED.
binding_fix: per-leg signed funding cost at each measured settlement ts inside [entry_ts, exit_ts]: cost += f_leg * notional_leg * position_side_sign, position_side_sign = +1 for the long-pays convention on positive funding
cadence read per symbol per window from the re-proved series (settlement count is data); the '3x2' enumeration deleted or restated as an upper bound under the MEASURED cadence
boundary rule: settlements with ts == entry_ts or ts == exit_ts charged (inclusive), pre-declared
